title: Calling a taxi
instructions: Mary telefonda taksi çağırıyor. Kısa bir diyalog; adrese ve süreye dikkat et.

script.speaker: mary
script.text: Hello. I need a taxi to the airport, please.

script.speaker: driver
script.text: OK. The taxi is there in fifteen minutes.

script.speaker: mary
script.text: Thank you. I have three big bags.

script.speaker: driver
script.text: No problem. It's a big car.

questions.prompt: Where does Mary want to go?
questions.evidence: I need a taxi to the airport, please.

questions.feedback: Taksi on beş dakika içinde (in fifteen minutes) gelecek. "Fifteen" ile "fifty" karışmasın.
questions.evidence: The taxi is there in fifteen minutes.

questions.prompt: How many bags does Mary have?
questions.feedback: Üç büyük çantası (three big bags) var.
